title: 第7章 天山女侠传第8章 我们的女神啊
slug: 玄幻开局吃软饭出世即儒圣
content_zh:
饭后，沈无名都打算回府了，曹茱萸还跟在他的屁股后面，不愿意离开。
“曹大人，我得先回去了，告辞。”
沈无名实在被缠得不行，看到楚平山吃完，就赶紧放下筷子跟着离开。
可曹茱萸还是不愿意放过他，拉着他的衣袖，清了清嗓子。
“沈公子，你真的不考虑加入墨家吗？”曹茱萸满脸认真。
“以你的天赋和悟性，将来就是成为墨家巨子都很有机会啊！”
“不想！”沈无名摇了摇头，“万般皆下品，唯有读书高，我要修儒家。”
主要是他不想学理科。
他最近这段时间也看到不少的各家修行之道，儒家是修炼最快的。
以笔为刀，以诗为剑！
随随便便抄几首唐诗宋词，修为就可以突飞猛进，干嘛要去搞手艺活儿？
没有得到想要的答案，曹茱萸忍不住眉头微蹙，“你真的不再考虑一下？”
“只要你加入墨家，我保举你进入鲁山书院，而且还可以给书院院长推荐你当他亲传弟子。”
原本走在前方的楚平山，听到书院院长的时候，也忍不住顿下脚步。
他知道鲁山书院院长，那可是一尊巨头。
不仅是墨家九算之一，而且还是当朝工部尚书。
仅次于几位宰相的大人物。
不过他还没说话，沈无名就果断摇头，“还是不想！”
“你……”曹茱萸脸色一沉，抬手指着沈无名，“你知不知道你错过了什么？”
“错过了什么？一位墨家大佬吗？”沈无名并不在意。

他原本打算修行儒家，只是因为儒家方便。
可此时曹茱萸再三劝说，反倒激起了他的逆反心理。
曹茱萸恨铁不成钢道：“你不是错过了院长，而是错过了发挥天赋的机会。”
“你修儒家不一定走得通，但墨家一定可以，你知道你的天赋有多好吗？”
曹茱萸说到这里，语气也柔和了下来，她只当是沈无名没意识到他自己的厉害。
“你知道你刚才的发现有多么重要吗？不同性质金属的排水量，甚至可以延伸到更多领域……”
见曹茱萸并非以权势压人，反而是这般姿态，沈无名也放低了声音。
“我知道，刚才只是让你用金属做实验，其实你也可以用石头和金属，还有木块这些……”
“对。”曹茱萸眼睛一亮，情不自禁抓住他的手，“所以我说你是天才。”
“我把你这些东西整理出来，明天就可以发在朝廷邸报上面……”
朝廷邸报相当于官办报纸，不仅有时事，也会发一些百家学说。
因为邸报的面积有限，每一篇发在上面的文章，都极具竞争力。
而且一经发表，自己的学说被人认可，念力加持，还可增长修为。
类似于传道的效果。
不过沈无名并没有在意这些，而是感受到她的小手，冰冰凉凉的，极为嫩滑。
就像是剥了壳的鸡蛋似的。
“咳咳咳！”
楚平山忍不住轻咳两声，“曹大人，我知道你爱才心切！”
“不过这还是在外面，你们要不要注意一下这个……影响不太好……”
曹茱萸这才注意到自己的手，满不在意地松开，还是热切地看着沈无名。

沈无名叹了一口气，也看出来了曹茱萸的性格，若是断然拒绝，她定然是不会放弃。
“唉……”沈无名面带犹豫，“曹大人，容我思考之后再给你回复，如何？”
“好……吧……”曹茱萸想了想，还是点点头，然后挥挥手。
“什么时候想好了，随时到督造司来找我，我带你去鲁山书院。”
……
content_en:
After the meal, Shen Wuming was about to go back home, but Cao Juyu was still following him, unwilling to leave.
"Master Cao, I have to go back first and say goodbye."
Shen Wuming was really troubled. When he saw Chu Pingshan finishing his meal, he quickly put down his chopsticks and left.
But Cao Juyu still didn't want to let him go, so she pulled his sleeve and cleared his throat.
"Mr. Shen, are you really not considering joining the Mo family?" Cao Zhuyu said with a serious face.
"With your talent and understanding, you have a good chance of becoming a Mohist giant in the future!"
"I don't want to!" Shen Wuming shook his head, "Everything is low-grade, but I want to be good at studying. I want to practice Confucianism."
Mainly because he didn't want to study science.
He has also seen a lot of cultivation methods from various schools recently, and Confucianism is the fastest.
Use the pen as a knife and poetry as a sword!
If you just copy a few Tang poems and Song lyrics, your cultivation will improve by leaps and bounds. Why do you need to do craft work?
Not getting the answer she wanted, Cao Zhuyu couldn't help but frown slightly, "Are you really not thinking about it anymore?"
"As long as you join the Mo family, I recommend you to enter Lushan Academy, and I can also recommend you to the dean of the academy to be his direct disciple."
Chu Pingshan, who was originally walking in front, couldn't help but pause when he heard the president of the academy.
He knew that the dean of Lushan Academy was a giant.
Not only was he one of the nine calculations of the Mohist family, but he was also the minister of the Ministry of Industry of the current dynasty.
A big shot second only to several prime ministers.
But before he spoke, Shen Wuming shook his head decisively, "I still don't want to!"
"You..." Cao Zhuyu's face darkened and she raised her finger to point at Shen Wuming, "Do you know what you missed?"
"What did you miss? A Mo family boss?" Shen Wuming didn't care.
He originally planned to practice Confucianism just because it was convenient.
But at this time, Cao Zhuyu's repeated persuasion aroused his rebellious psychology.
Cao Zhuyu said, "You didn't miss the chance to be the dean, but you missed the opportunity to display your talent."
"You may not be able to succeed if you practice Confucianism, but you can certainly do it if you practice Mohism. Do you know how good your talent is?"
When Cao Zhuyu said this, her tone softened. She just thought that Shen Wuming didn't realize how powerful he was.
"Do you know how important your discovery just now is? The drainage of metals with different properties can even extend to more areas..."
Seeing that Cao Juyu was not using power to suppress others, but rather acting like this, Shen Wuming also lowered his voice.
"I know, I just asked you to do experiments with metals. In fact, you can also use stones, metals, and wooden blocks..."
"Yes." Cao Zhuyu's eyes lit up and she couldn't help but grab his hand, "That's why I say you are a genius."
"I'll sort out these things for you and publish them in the imperial palace newspaper tomorrow..."
The imperial newspaper is equivalent to a government-run newspaper. It not only publishes current affairs, but also publishes some theories from hundreds of schools of thought.
Because the Di Bao's area is limited, every article published on it is extremely competitive.
Moreover, once published, one's theory will be recognized by others, and with the blessing of mind power, one can also increase one's cultivation level.
Similar to the effect of preaching.
However, Shen Wuming didn't care about this, but felt her little hands, which were cold and extremely tender.
Like an egg that has been peeled.
"Cough cough cough!"
Chu Pingshan couldn't help coughing twice, "Master Cao, I know you love me so much!"
"But this is still outside. Do you want to pay attention to this...the impact is not very good..."
Only then did Cao Zhuyu notice her hand and let go of it nonchalantly, still looking at Shen Wuming eagerly.
Shen Wuming sighed and saw Cao Zhuyu's character. If she refused categorically, she would definitely not give up.
"Alas..." Shen Wuming looked hesitant, "Master Cao, how about you let me think about it before I reply to you?"
"Okay... Okay..." Cao Zhuyu thought for a while, nodded, and thenWave.
"Whenever you think about it, come to me at the Supervision Department at any time and I will take you to Lushan Academy."
